1.consolidated_definition: Examen corto. Prueba breve oral o escrita y menos formal que un examen regular. Anglicismo crudo, frecuente. Cogí cálculo dos, con la misma maestra y a la misma hora, de siete a siete cincuenta todos los díasy los viernes tengo quizzes, así que no puedo faltar (Norma Culta joven, 11, 1995)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Brief examination. A short oral or written test that is less formal than a regular exam. Angloism, often used in informal contexts. I took calculus two with the same teacher and at the same time every day from seven to seven fifty, and on Fridays I have quizzes, so I cannot miss (Norma Culta joven, 11, 1995)
